newsitem.title: JAPAN: DuPont aims to double share value by 2002.
newsitem.headline: DuPont aims to double share value by 2002.

text.p: Dupont Co aims to double its share value to $80 billion by 2002 from $40 billion in 1995, its chairman said on Tuesday.

"One of our financial goals is to double our shareholders' value to $80 billion in 2002," Edgar Woolard told reporters. He said the strong U.S. share market has also recently contributed to a rise in the company's shareholders' value.

Woolard, on a visit to Tokyo, said the company was considering more joint ventures in Asia. "We have 30 joint ventures in Asia, and are in process of evaluating at least 50 additional joint ventures," Woolard said.
